summary.text: Maxine Mosley is a Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Hillsborough 16, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Mosley lost the Democratic primary on September 8, 2026, and Ballotpedia reports that the Democratic Party then selected her to fill a vacancy on its ticket; she also ran in Hillsborough 39 in 2024, when she advanced from the primary but lost the general election.
